A LITTLE ROCKET SCIENCE
Acceleration changes velocity.
It doesn’t erase it.
The engine’s force divided by spacecraft mass gives its acceleration contribution. Lunar gravity acts at the same time.
a = F / m thrust acceleration · m/s²
Why can the engine be on while you descend?
An upward force can reduce a downward velocity before it reverses direction. Landing depends on how much time and distance remain for braking.
Why does pointing matter?
The engine pushes along the spacecraft’s body +X axis. Tilting redirects some force sideways, leaving less to counter gravity. The 2D view projects an underlying 3D state.
What do Apollo’s accelerometers measure?
PIPAs measure specific force: total acceleration minus gravity. In ideal free fall their output is zero. Earlier native experiments returned physical sensor pulses to original Luminary navigation; this manual lab does not claim that its landing was AGC controlled.
What is authentic here?
The original AGC replay and live attitude laboratory retain verified Luminary execution. This separate educational flight uses the existing engine model, explicit synthetic initial conditions and modern manual controls. A model or fallback agent never impersonates the AGC.
